data.title: AI boom fuels demand for commercial and industrial space: JLL
data.description: JLL's Christian Ulbrich says commercial real estate demand is robust, with office leasing rising on steady GDP growth and AI companies among the strongest drivers. He says industrial space is also in strong demand, driven by data center buildout, but access to grid power is the main constraint on new data centers.
